svg.aria-label: In a Claude Code session two install commands are typed and each gets a tick. Then, in your project, asking improve my SEO in plain words gets a cross and does nothing, while typing /eco:eco-readme runs Eco on a README and typing /eco:eco-site runs Eco on a website: Eco starts only from its commands.
svg.text: Install once, then type the command
Eco runs only when you call it by name.
